title: Pinki Kumari
text:
Hi, I’m Pinki Kumari, pursuing M.Tech. In Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar.
I am working under the supervision of Dr. Anirban Dasgupta on “Hashing Algorithms for efficient training of Large Language Models and applying Locality Sensitive Hashing on Neural Tangent Kernels (LSH on NTK)”.
